finder.title: DTG printing
finder.allText:
01 / 04
DTG printing
Material & application
Cotton and cotton-rich apparel.
Before production
Confirm fabric composition, garment colour, artwork size and placement. Approve colour on a physical sample.

finder.title: Computerised embroidery
finder.allText:
02 / 04
Computerised embroidery
Material & application
Caps, polos and bags suitable for embroidery.
Before production
Share the logo size and placement. Small lettering and fine details need review when digitising the stitch file.

finder.title: Sublimation printing
finder.allText:
03 / 04
Sublimation printing
Material & application
Polyester apparel and sportswear suitable for sublimation.
Before production
Confirm fabric composition, base colour, pattern layout and seams. Test colour on the intended material.

finder.title: Laser cutting & engraving
finder.allText:
04 / 04
Laser cutting & engraving
Material & application
Wood, acrylic, leather or fabric confirmed as suitable by the team.
Before production
Provide material type, thickness and cutting paths. Confirm the finish on a sample before approving the run.

faq.summary:
Can I start with a small order?
+
faq.content: Yes. DTG and sublimation orders can start from a single unit. Custom blanks and made-to-measure uniforms have minimum quantities agreed for each project.
faq.full:
Can I start with a small order?
+

Yes. DTG and sublimation orders can start from a single unit. Custom blanks and made-to-measure uniforms have minimum quantities agreed for each project.

faq.summary:
What artwork files do you need?
+
faq.content: Send vector artwork (AI, EPS, SVG or PDF), or a transparent PNG at 300 DPI at the final print size. Our team checks the file before it moves into production.
faq.full:
What artwork files do you need?
+

Send vector artwork (AI, EPS, SVG or PDF), or a transparent PNG at 300 DPI at the final print size. Our team checks the file before it moves into production.

faq.summary:
Can we approve a sample first?
+
faq.content: Yes. Our Me Linh plant has a dedicated sampling line. For larger orders, we recommend agreeing a sample before the full production run.
faq.full:
Can we approve a sample first?
+

Yes. Our Me Linh plant has a dedicated sampling line. For larger orders, we recommend agreeing a sample before the full production run.

faq.summary:
How do we confirm pricing and lead time?
+
faq.content: Share the product, design, expected quantity and shipping destination. We will review the production requirements and discuss pricing, timing and shipping with you before you proceed.
faq.full:
How do we confirm pricing and lead time?
+

Share the product, design, expected quantity and shipping destination. We will review the production requirements and discuss pricing, timing and shipping with you before you proceed.
